title: A lot of people say they believe in God.
paragraphs: A lot of people say they believe in God.
But James 2:19 says even demons believe — and tremble.

The question isn’t:
“Do you believe God exists?”

The real question is:
Have you repented?

Because belief alone doesn’t change a heart.
Repentance does.
James 2:19 says demons believe in God and tremble.
What makes a believer different from a demon?
Be honest. What do you think? 👇
